title: Learn and apply turn feedback into findings the existing gates check, and no report edits a fact
goal: querylog.py learn reads stored feedback: an outcome replaces Haiku's judged for its entry (the re-run on HEAD still decides fixed-since); a best article gives an eval finding at stage miss with that best, which apply's alias and expansion gates take as today; missed with a lead url and claim gives a gap finding whose research run receives the url and claim as quoted data; a line marked wrong with a url and claim gives a conflict finding that apply records in _conflicts.md as not settled only when quotecheck finds the claim on the page, and writes no fact; a line marked stale gives a report-only source finding for its source id; tool_issue counts per tool in the digest; helpful and irrelevant are reported, never applied; a second learn and apply on unchanged inputs change nothing.

gates.question: Where does a gap or conflict finding get its report's claim, when the store keeps only closed fields (D-666asy3d) and distill (ST-qqyvoqyj) keeps the claim in the spool only
options: apply reads the claim from the spool row whose closed shape equals the stored report, and a finding carries only its gated lead or source id; a row already delivered leaves the finding without a claim
a closed claim field on the stored report or the finding
gates.recommendation: apply reads the claim from the spool row whose closed shape equals the stored report, and a finding carries only its gated lead or source id; a row already delivered leaves the finding without a claim
gates.answer: apply reads the claim from the spool row whose closed shape equals the stored report, and a finding carries only its gated lead or source id; a row already delivered leaves the finding without a claim

gates.question: Should the query log's recorded fields keep a report's claim beyond the spool, so a conflict check or research run in a later apply, on another machine or after delivery, still has it
options: no: the query log's store keeps closed fields only (D-666asy3d); a claim reaches the conflict check and research only while the spool row exists, and a conflict finding without it waits open
yes: a closed claim field (at most FEEDBACK_CLAIM_WORDS words, leak-scanned) on the stored report
gates.recommendation: no: the query log's store keeps closed fields only (D-666asy3d); a claim reaches the conflict check and research only while the spool row exists, and a conflict finding without it waits open
gates.answer: no: the query log's store keeps closed fields only (D-666asy3d); a claim reaches the conflict check and research only while the spool row exists, and a conflict finding without it waits open

gates.question: Which report decides a lookup's judgement when several joined it, and how does the outcome misled count
options: the last report with an outcome in time order, and misled counts as missed
a person's report before an agent's, and misled counts as partly
gates.recommendation: the last report with an outcome in time order, and misled counts as missed
gates.answer: the last report with an outcome in time order, and misled counts as missed

gates.question: What does a conflict entry in a root's _conflicts.md hold, since the claim is checked on the page and a quote is never stored
options: the line, the page's url, the finding id and not settled, tagged UNK, without the claim's words
the claim's words as the page's quote, tagged with a new source row
gates.recommendation: the line, the page's url, the finding id and not settled, tagged UNK, without the claim's words
gates.answer: the line, the page's url, the finding id and not settled, tagged UNK, without the claim's words

gates.answer: no: the check runs no model and only fetches the page, so it runs in every apply

gates.question: To which tool does the digest count a report's tool issue, since a report names none
options: each kb tool its lookup used, and a dash when the entry lists none
gates.recommendation: each kb tool its lookup used, and a dash when the entry lists none
gates.answer: each kb tool its lookup used, and a dash when the entry lists none

gates.question: How does a stale mark become a finding and when does it close, and what does a wrong mark without a page make
options: a source finding with signal stale per cited source id, fixed-since once the source was retrieved after the newest report; a wrong mark with no page makes no finding and is counted in the digest
a stale source finding that stays open until a person closes it; a wrong mark with no page makes a gap finding
gates.recommendation: a source finding with signal stale per cited source id, fixed-since once the source was retrieved after the newest report; a wrong mark with no page makes no finding and is counted in the digest
gates.answer: a source finding with signal stale per cited source id, fixed-since once the source was retrieved after the newest report; a wrong mark with no page makes no finding and is counted in the digest

gates.question: What names do the new findings and their fields take in the findings files
options: kind conflict at stage miss with fields line and lead or source_id; a gap finding's field lead; signal stale with source_id on a source finding
kind feedback-conflict with a url field and no source id
